comment.narrative:
Output 1: 1.1. Developing and presenting capacity building plans and business strategies for marketing activities for the three selected enterprises 1.2. Training on employment of people with disabilities
Output 2: 2.1 Assessment of the existing capacity and development of recommendations for the procurement of cardboard and printing equipment for Training and Production Enterprise (TPE) No. 1 in Ashgabat and sewing equipment for two TPEs in Mary and Turkmenabat. 2.2. Conduct accessibility checks and develop an implementation plan and recommendations for the three enterprises of BDST 2.3 Carrying out major repairs of production areas in selected enterprises (safety, heating, electrical safety and fire safety) 2.4 Procurement, installation of cardboard printing equipment at the TPE No. 1 in Ashgabat and training of BDST employees on maintenance issues
Output 3 3.1 Developing an appropriate training programme for vocational training and conducting training for trainers and training for employees on the development of professional skills and equipment maintenance

Output 1:
1.1. BDST capacity building plans and business strategies of three social enterprises of BDST were developed by a national consultant incorporating the Chinese experience and presented to BDST. 1.2. 66 members of the Blind and Deaf Society of Turkmenistan, of which 43 are women, trained online by Chinese experts and trained trainers of the BDST on disability equality issues in Ashgabat, Mary and Turkmenabat.
Output 2: 2.1. The assessment of production capacities and recommendations for procurement of cardboard equipment for the Ashgabat social enterprise were developed by a national consultant with the support of Chinese experts. 2,2. Accessibility checks and recommendations for three enterprises of BDST were provided by Chinese experts 2.3. The RFQ for reconstruction of the cardboard-printing workshop in Ashgabat has been finalized and to be announced in early December 2021. 2.4. ITB for procurement and installation of cardboard printing equipment at the TPE No. 1 in Ashgabat and training of BDST employees on maintenance issues was announced and selection of bidders is to be completed by end of December 2021.
Output 3: 3.1. An appropriate training programme for employees of the cardboard and printing workshop of TPE N 1 in Ashgabat on operation of new equipment is to be conducted by the supplier of new equipment in 2022.

Output 2
2.1. Assessment of the existing capacity and development of recommendations for procurement of sewing equipment for two sewing workshops of BDST in Mary and Turkmenabat (national consultants). 2.2. Conduct accessibility checks and develop recommendations for two sewing workshops of BDST (Chinese experts based on the reports by national consultants) 2.3 Carrying out major repairs of production areas in selected enterprises (safety, heating, electrical safety and fire safety) 2.4 Procurement, installation of equipment at three selected BDST workshops in Ashgabat, Mary and Turkmenabat
Output 3
3.1 Training of personnel of three selected enterprises on operation and maintenance of new equipment (national consultant) 3.2 Develop a manual on apprenticeship (hiring, induction training, on-job training, accessibility of work place) for newly hired blind and deaf people under mentorship of BDST production specialists (national consultant with the support of Chinese experts) 3.3 Develop partnerships to promote vocational education and employment for people with disabilities 3.4 Raising awareness of the social model of disability and inclusive approaches

Output 2
2.1. The existing capacity of two sewing workshops of BDST in Mary and Turkmenabat was assessed and recommendations for procurement of sewing equipment were made by national consultants with the support of Chinese experts. 2.2. Accessibility checks and recommendations for reconstruction of two sewing workshops of BDST in Mary and Turkmenabat were made by Chinese experts based on the assessment reports by national consultants 2.3 The construction company was selected, and repair works started at the BDST printing workshop in Ashgabat. The start of repair works at the two sewing workshops in Mary and Turkmenabat is expected in 2023. The completion of all repair works is expected by the end of April 2023. In this regard, the extension of the project was requested. 2.4 Procurement of printing and sewing equipment for three workshops nears completion. The delivery of sewing equipment is expected by the end of December 2022, and printing equipment – by early February 2023.
Output 3
3.1 Training of personnel of three selected enterprises on operation and maintenance of new equipment will be conducted after delivery and installation of equipment at the BDST workshops in early 2023. 3.2 A manual on apprenticeship (hiring, induction training, on-job training, accessibility of work place) for newly hired blind and deaf people under mentorship of BDST production specialists will be started in 2023 following the project extension. 3.3 National consultants for development of partnerships to promote vocational education and employment for people with disabilities will be recruited in early 2023 following the project extension. 3.4 The project conducted a round table on disability inclusive development in employment, vocational education and social protection under the overarching theme “Socio-economic integration of people with disabilities in Turkmenistan” on the eve of International Day of Persons with Disability, raising key stakeholders’ awareness of a model of employment of persons with disabilities in the open labor market of Turkmenistan that would enable persons with disabilities to receive decent education, including secondary vocational and higher education, and relevant professional skills applicable in the labor market of Turkmenistan, both in public and private sectors.
The Project to be approved and signed by national partner.
The Project was approved by GOVT and signed by national partner in December 2020.
